bechacant.project: Web and PWA products built with React, Next.js and TypeScript, with backend services and AI-powered features. Ran in parallel with my last months at eTeam.
bechacant.result: Owned paywalls, subscriptions and store receipt verification end to end, and put the first LLM features - RAG, streaming, tool calling - into production.
bechacant.responsibilities:
Built product features end to end: paywalls and in-app purchases, offline-friendly mobile-first PWAs with push notifications, and parts of a code editor UI (editing, tabs, file tree, live preview).

Backend in NestJS and Express with REST and GraphQL: payments and subscriptions with store receipt verification, webhooks and background jobs for renewal and expiry, PostgreSQL with safe logging and access rules.

LLM features in production: RAG retrieval, streaming responses, tool calling and agent-style flows, with the prompt design behind them. Wrote the spec before the code and kept both in sync.
bechacant.interest: Fixing the hard bugs: endless request loops, wrong deep-link routing, timezone drift, layouts collapsing under large system fonts. Also set up shared AI coding rules and prompts for the team.
